entries.text: High burst units like claymores / yorkist.
Shield units, big blob impact (CC + tanking), and any units that are weak to fire.

steps.text: Press 1 (Righteous Charge): charge that knocks down enemies, or acts as a dash if used from melee range. Press 2 (Zeal Whirlwind): close-range slam.

steps.context: transformed form (Inquisitor, activate Press 3 / Judgment Day when fully charged)
steps.text: Press 2 remains the slam. Press 1 (Dies irae) becomes a vacuum that partially pulls enemies toward you. During the transformation you are immobilized and vulnerable, so it is best to activate Press 3 outside of fights to heal and then return to fight. Never transform mid-fight -- once the transformation animation starts, you cannot cancel it; you are stuck until the animation finishes.

steps.context: engage (not transformed, or transformed but without spell)
steps.text: It is BETTER to X-move close to a fight and let enemies aggro you rather than pressing V. Try this in a custom game vs AI to see how much better it is.

You can ENRAGE Zealots yourself before a fight with a Scorpio (likely the Scorpio siege engine's fire effect, per in-thread cross-reference -- not independently verified). Once "fire" mode is ON, it stays until the end of the game, even if you swap units or die.
The description says "get kills" but actually counts artillery/treb kills, hero kills, AND taking hits (any damage amount) toward Mad Malice.
